""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the provided user content safely. Parameters ---------- client_input : str The raw string supplied by the user to be inserted into the page. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Escape any special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Render the final page using the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
